<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const kicker = document.querySelector("#home-kicker");
  const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;

  if (!kicker || reduceMotion) return;

  const text = Array.from(kicker.dataset.text || kicker.textContent);
  let position = 0;

  kicker.setAttribute("aria-label", text.join(""));
  kicker.textContent = "";
  kicker.classList.add("is-typing");

  const typeNextCharacter = () => {
    kicker.textContent += text[position];
    position += 1;

    if (position < text.length) {
      window.setTimeout(typeNextCharacter, 55);
    } else {
      window.setTimeout(() => kicker.classList.remove("is-typing"), 900);
    }
  };

  window.setTimeout(typeNextCharacter, 450);
});
</script>
